subject.title: feat(skill-workshop): add restore action for quarantined proposals and display scan findings

question: Should a quarantined proposal with unresolved critical findings be allowed to return to pending status while apply remains fail-closed through a mandatory fresh scan?
rationale: The code can preserve the write boundary, but whether quarantine is a terminal review state or a recoverable workflow state is a security and product lifecycle decision that source inspection cannot authorize.

options.title: Allow guarded restore
options.body: Accept quarantined-to-pending restore only with explicit tests proving unresolved findings remain visible and every apply path re-scans and re-quarantines before writing.

options.title: Revise while quarantined
options.body: Keep the quarantine status until content is changed and cleanly re-scanned, exposing revision actions without a separate pending transition.

options.title: Keep quarantine terminal
options.body: Reject the restore API and limit recovery to creating a replacement proposal through the existing workflow.

recommendation.title: Allow guarded restore
recommendation.body: Accept quarantined-to-pending restore only with explicit tests proving unresolved findings remain visible and every apply path re-scans and re-quarantines before writing.

likelyOwner.reason: The original proposal lifecycle, guarded actions, and public Skill Workshop contract appear to be primarily associated with this feature history.
